newsitem.title: BULGARIA: New Bulgaria cabinet sacks oil refinery directors.
newsitem.headline: New Bulgaria cabinet sacks oil refinery directors.

text.p: Bulgaria's new interim cabinet on Thursday sacked the board of directors of the country's biggest oil refinery Neftohim, the government press centre said.
Two executive directors have been appointed, Nikola Karagyozov, who has been so far the plant's production director and Atanas Zaykov, who has been the plant's financial director.

The new board of state employees includes plant officials Georgi Vassilev and Georgi Andonov, as well as Eli Getova who will be a deputy minister in the industry ministry and Dimitar Bachvarov who will head the government's economic department.
The seventh board member is expected to be appointed on Monday and could be a minister.

Officials said the previous board was not released from its responsibility for the current situation of Neftohim, which lacks cash to pay for crude supplies. For the last two weeks the country has been choked by a severe petrol crisis.
Within two weeks the new board is due to prepare a stabilisation programme for the refinery.
A package of measures will include steps towards preventing speculative exports of gasoline, which have been made also by state firms.
The cabinet, which took office on Thursday, will also introduce changes in the board of state gas firm Bulgargas.
